title: WEIRDLabUW/sgft
abstract: SGFT This repo contains the code for: Rapidly Adapting Policies to the Real-World via Simulation-Guided Fine-Tuning. Patrick Yin*, Tyler Westenbroek*, Simran Bagaria, Kevin Huang, Ching-An Cheng, Andrey Kolobov, Abhishek Gupta. arXiV preprint 2025. Project Page: [https://weirdlabuw.github.io/sgft/](https://weirdlabuw.github.io/sgft/). ---- ## Overview SGFT accelerates real-world finetuning by simply relabeling the reward with potential-based shaping using the value function learned in simulation. It is a simple change on top of your favorite off-policy RL method. In this codebase, we make a simple change on top of TDMPC2 and demonstrate our method on a sim2sim DMC task. ---- ## Getting started Install dependencies via `conda` by running the following command: ### Training and Finetuning ---- ## Acknowledgments This codebase is built upon the original work by Nicklas Hansen on TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control. The original can be found at: https://github.com/nicklashansen/tdmpc2. If you use this code, please also cite the original authors as specified in their repository: ## Citations If you find our work useful, please consider citing our paper as follows: ## License This project is dervied from TD-MPC2, which is licensed under the MIT License - see the `LICENSE` file for details. abstract_zh: SGFT通过使用仿真中学习的价值函数进行基于势的奖励重塑，加速了真实世界的微调。它是在现有离策略强化学习方法之上的简单改动。在本代码库中，我们在TDMPC2之上进行了简单修改，并在sim2sim DMC任务上展示了我们的方法。
tldr_zh: 用仿真价值函数重塑奖励，加速真实世界策略微调。
cover_zh: 仿真训练直接迁移到真实世界？这个微调方法让策略适应快得惊人
